title: Vehicle Selector Pro — Merchant Command Center

scenes.narration: Vehicle Selector Pro. The fitment command center for Shopify automotive stores.
Open the dashboard and the whole catalog is legible at once. Mapped products, vehicle coverage, rule health, and live sync status in a single view.
The fitment matrix says exactly what fits. Every product-to-vehicle mapping, its fit type, and its verification state all live here — direct fit, universal, or held for review.
Behind the matrix is the normalized vehicle library. Year, make, model, trim, and engine — the same tree your shoppers will filter by, kept fast with a local cache.
Selector settings ship straight to the Theme App Extension. Labels, brand color, selector depth, garage limits — merchant controlled, no code.
Bulk CSV import maps hundreds of products in one pass, staged and reviewed before anything reaches the storefront.
Fitment data syncs to Shopify metafields through GraphQL in Sidekiq batches. Webhooks keep the cache honest — every App Proxy request HMAC-verified.
Vehicle Selector Pro. Fitment intelligence, built for Rails, ready for production.
